row.proto: void Vm_Add_ChoiceListItem(void *list_vm, const char *name, const char *text, void *icon_handle, const char *available, uint8_t icon_visible, const char *icon_text)
row.notes: Creates a child named by djb2(name) under the list node (+0x48) and fills "name", "text", "localised"=false, an icon node ref, "icon_visible", an index child (hash 0x0fa9159d) taken from the current "data_size" (+0x88), "available", "icon_justified_text", "icon_justified_text_localised"=false and "icon_justified_text_visible" (true when icon_text is non-empty). If data_size was 0 it sets current_selection (+0x68) to the new item, then increments data_size and releases icon_handle.
